aufgaben_faellig_ck.name: aufgaben_faellig_ck
aufgaben_faellig_ck.value: ("aufgaben"."faellig_date" is null or "aufgaben"."faellig_utc" is null) and ("aufgaben"."faellig_utc" is null or "aufgaben"."tzid" is not null)

datei_blob_key_ck.name: datei_blob_key_ck
datei_blob_key_ck.value: ("datei_blob"."modus" = 'server' and "datei_blob"."dek_wrap" is not null and "datei_blob"."kid" is not null) or ("datei_blob"."modus" = 'e2ee' and "datei_blob"."dek_wrap" is null and "datei_blob"."kid" is null)

datei_blob_claim_ck.name: datei_blob_claim_ck
datei_blob_claim_ck.value: ("datei_blob"."state" = 'claimed') = ("datei_blob"."claim_entity" is not null and "datei_blob"."claim_id" is not null)

guardian_escrows_size_ck.name: guardian_escrows_size_ck
guardian_escrows_size_ck.value: length("guardian_escrows"."blob") between 64 and 2048 and length("guardian_escrows"."sig") between 64 and 256 and "guardian_escrows"."key_version" >= 1 and "guardian_escrows"."guardian_key_version" >= 1

invites_kind_ck.name: invites_kind_ck
invites_kind_ck.value: "invites"."kind" in ('standard', 'password_reset') and ("invites"."kind" = 'standard' or "invites"."user_id" is not null)

key_backups_prf_size_ck.name: key_backups_prf_size_ck
key_backups_prf_size_ck.value: length("key_backups_prf"."blob") between 96 and 4096 and "key_backups_prf"."key_version" >= 1 and length("key_backups_prf"."credential_id") between 1 and 1024

konversationen_teilnehmer_ck.name: konversationen_teilnehmer_ck
konversationen_teilnehmer_ck.value:
("konversationen"."art" = 'family' and cardinality("konversationen"."teilnehmer") = 0)
        or ("konversationen"."art" = 'direct' and cardinality("konversationen"."teilnehmer") = 2)
        or ("konversationen"."art" = 'group' and cardinality("konversationen"."teilnehmer") between 2 and 20)
        or ("konversationen"."art"::text = 'meds' and cardinality("konversationen"."teilnehmer") between 1 and 20)
        or ("konversationen"."art"::text = 'zaehler' and cardinality("konversationen"."teilnehmer") between 1 and 20)
        or ("konversationen"."art"::text = 'tresor' and cardinality("konversationen"."teilnehmer") between 1 and 20)

operator_metrics_nonneg_ck.name: operator_metrics_nonneg_ck
operator_metrics_nonneg_ck.value: "operator_metrics"."active_persons_7" >= 0 and "operator_metrics"."active_persons_30" >= 0 and "operator_metrics"."active_devices_7" >= 0 and "operator_metrics"."active_devices_30" >= 0 and "operator_metrics"."sync_runs" >= 0 and "operator_metrics"."sync_errors" >= 0 and "operator_metrics"."rate_limited" >= 0 and ("operator_metrics"."db_bytes" is null or "operator_metrics"."db_bytes" >= 0) and ("operator_metrics"."files_bytes" is null or "operator_metrics"."files_bytes" >= 0)

operator_settings_notice_ck.name: operator_settings_notice_ck
operator_settings_notice_ck.value: "operator_settings"."notice_text" is null or (length("operator_settings"."notice_text") between 1 and 280 and "operator_settings"."notice_set_at" is not null)

termin_ausnahmen_zeit_len_ck.name: termin_ausnahmen_zeit_len_ck
termin_ausnahmen_zeit_len_ck.value: ("termin_ausnahmen"."start" is null or char_length("termin_ausnahmen"."start") between 10 and 20) and ("termin_ausnahmen"."ende" is null or char_length("termin_ausnahmen"."ende") between 10 and 20)

termine_zeit_ck.name: termine_zeit_ck
termine_zeit_ck.value:
("termine"."ganztaegig" and "termine"."start_date" is not null and "termine"."end_date" is not null and "termine"."end_date" > "termine"."start_date")
        or (not "termine"."ganztaegig" and "termine"."start_utc" is not null and "termine"."end_utc" is not null and "termine"."tzid" is not null and "termine"."end_utc" >= "termine"."start_utc")

user_avatars_size_ck.name: user_avatars_size_ck
user_avatars_size_ck.value: octet_length("user_avatars"."data") between 1 and 524288 and "user_avatars"."width" between 1 and 1024 and "user_avatars"."height" between 1 and 1024

users_removed_ck.name: users_removed_ck
users_removed_ck.value: "users"."removed_at" is null or "users"."disabled_at" is not null

users_avatar_ck.name: users_avatar_ck
users_avatar_ck.value: ("users"."avatar_kind" is null and "users"."avatar_preset" is null) or ("users"."avatar_kind" = 'preset' and "users"."avatar_preset" is not null) or ("users"."avatar_kind" = 'photo' and "users"."avatar_preset" is null)
